-- Step 1: Archive current versions to history (correct schema)
INSERT INTO sequenceTemplateHistory (templateId, prevSubject, prevBodyText, prevBodyHtml, editedBy, changeNote)
SELECT id, subjectLine, bodyText, bodyHtml, 'system', 'address_fix: 3945 Peachtree Pkwy → 2005 Lawrenceville-Suwanee Rd'
FROM sequenceTemplates
WHERE id IN (60001, 60002, 60003, 60004, 60005);

-- Step 2: Fix bodyText (all variants of the wrong address)
UPDATE sequenceTemplates
SET bodyText = REPLACE(
  REPLACE(bodyText, '3945 Peachtree Pkwy, Suwanee, GA 30024', '2005 Lawrenceville-Suwanee Rd, Suwanee, GA 30024'),
  '3945 Peachtree Pkwy', '2005 Lawrenceville-Suwanee Rd')
WHERE id IN (60001, 60002, 60003, 60004, 60005);

-- Step 3: Fix bodyHtml (all variants of the wrong address)
UPDATE sequenceTemplates
SET bodyHtml = REPLACE(
  REPLACE(bodyHtml, '3945 Peachtree Pkwy, Suwanee, GA 30024', '2005 Lawrenceville-Suwanee Rd, Suwanee, GA 30024'),
  '3945 Peachtree Pkwy', '2005 Lawrenceville-Suwanee Rd')
WHERE id IN (60001, 60002, 60003, 60004, 60005);
